full_judgment: 57. In the plaint, it was averred that along with the other lands, the first schedule land belonged to Riaz Ullah Waqf Estate, enrolled as E.G. No. 12876 and the same was recorded in the name of the late , Asidullah, the then Mutwalli, father of the present Mutawalli Md. Kalimullah. Defendant No.1 as plaintiff earlier filed Title Suit No.26 of 1992 in the same Court. Former Mutwalli,  Asidullah by taking prior sanction from the Administrator of Waqfs, vide his Memo No. 2270 dated 15-5-1965 granted lease of 92 decimals of land out of dag No.932 and 08 decimals of land out of dag No. 923 at a Nazrana of Taka 300. The lessee paid the Nazrana to the mutawalli-Asidullah on 18-5-1965, on which date lease deed was executed and registered in between the parties and possession of the lease hold land was handed over to the lessee, who continued to be in peaceful possession thereof in his own right. The plaintiff purchased 4 decimals of land from the adjacent dag No.933 from its owner Amzadullah by registered deed dated 21-12-1965 and opened a pathway over there for peaceful enjoyment of his leasehold land and then he brought Mutation Case No.5/1973-74 and DP Khatian No.1/234 was opened in his name. Later the plaintiff by filing Miscellaneous Case No.2/ 1987-88 prayed for inclusion of his name in the printed khatian where the present Mutawalli filed objection and the matter being heard in presence of both sides, the name of the plaintiff was entered in Chhapa khatian No.230 and he continued to possess by paying rents to the Government and re-claimed some portions thereof, planted fruit bearing trees and vegetables and also dug a well for water and has been in possession thereof for over more than the period of limitation. The 'plaintiff also sold a part of the land in 1978 to one Moulana Solaiman, one of the defendants who being in possession engaged a caretaker, namely: Mukibur Rahman who started residing there with his brother, Maznur Rahman and they in collusion with the son of the former Mutawalli denied the title of Moulana Solaiman, who then brought Title Suit No.26 of 1990 in the Court of Assistant Judge for eviction of the aforesaid two brothers from his land. After the death of former mutawalli-Asidullah in 1979, his son Kalimullah, defendant No.1 (plaintiff of Title Suit No.26 of 1992) became the Mutawalli of the waqf estate and he in collusion with the owner of the adjacent dag Nos.922 and 929 tried to cut away earth forcibly by entering into dag No. 932, the plaintiff brought Title Suit No.38 of 1988 in the Court of Assistant Judge against defendant No.1 and others for permanent injunction and got an order of ad-interim injunction against them. But defendant No. 1 in collusion with defendant Nos.7-12 in order to grab the suit property and taking the advantage of the absence of the plaintiff dispossessed him from 3(three) decimals of land as described in the second schedule to the plaint and hurriedly erected 4(four) ekchala chhapra; hence the plaintiff was compelled to file the suit for the aforementioned reliefs.
